I closed TK-009: h4-900 is not a candidate. With a cap of 3 positions (same risk as the baseline) its KPI is worse than the baseline's in all three months.

Without a cap it held up to 29 positions at once (about 4× the account). With the cap, peak exposure stays under $1,500 on the $2,500 account.

| h4-900 vs baseline, both capped at 3 | Aug | Sep | Jul |
|---|---|---|---|
| KPI (lower is better) | 0.601 vs 0.368 | 0.088 vs 0.000 | 0.510 vs 0.416 |
| $ | +67 vs −16 | +82 vs +106 | +72 vs −19 |

The money is better in August and July, but these are point figures without intervals, so description only.

In the ticket log I noted that the Researcher's wording overstates this ("the edge is in the number of trades, not the selection"). My first log note also had a typo about September's KPI, which I corrected in a follow-up entry.
